why_retained: Pass 2 is kept because 28 histograms are better than the stored fit by more than 0.5 in chi-squared and none is worse (largest increase 0.0014). The curves follow each Acc025 histogram, including (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8), whose pinned B=-0.045 was the second-pass edge of a limit that excluded this histogram's cosine. The result was not moved onto nominal B=-0.125184 except where this histogram's cosine already lies there. Near-zero second-pass errors are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty. The trimmed-error list is histograms whose chi-squared already matched the cosine, so the limit was not opened. That trim is the fitter's second pass, not a smaller systematic uncertainty.
